about: An earlier run (run-2026-10-20-1000-migration) handled the comment under the Tobias rowing line, '%% Agent, the rowing line goes in idea-tobias and idea-mara. %%', with two units, both with trigger kind `comment` and text the comment holds: b1-u1 sent the line to idea-tobias and was kept, which gave the line its pointer; b1-u2 sent it to idea-mara and was undone. Its record is kept in .runs/units/. The line and the comment stayed off the handled list (spec-run-manager.md 11 Decisions Log items 81 and 83), so this run's scan hands both to the migrator again. The writer has since added a second comment under it, '%% Agent, he rows out in every weather. Put that in his note and hers. %%'. This run's migrator gives u1 a trigger of kind `comment` whose text only the new comment holds, and copies the line to idea-mara and to idea-tobias, the note the pointer names. The earlier b1-u1 sent the line to idea-tobias for a different comment, so the copy is not a repeat of the same trigger. `record` accepts it: exit 0, the cut-down record holds u1, and the run moves to verifying with fixing [u1].
spec: spec-run-manager.md 11 Decisions Log item 99 (the same trigger: the same kind, and for a comment, one comment in the piece holding both units' trigger text)
readings: Case 104 already covers an earlier unit of another kind (a tag); this case covers the same kind with another comment.
The earlier comment is still in the piece and still matches the earlier unit's trigger, so the code can match both units; they match different comments.
